As an AI Architect, you design solutions AI solutions for our clients that require traditional, generative, and agentic AI. You align with stakeholders to capture requirements and to design solutions and reference architectures in line with the necessary requirements.  

You work in close collaboration with Product Owners, Project Managers, Data Managers, Cloud Architects, Security Architects, and AI Experts, amongst others, to design compliant solutions that meet current and future requirements. You can translate high-level requirements into concrete solutions and make and explain the necessary tradeoffs. 

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in AI consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. You will be part of the Data & AI team, where we tackle AI challenges end to end, from strategy, governance, to science and engineering. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following: 

• At least 10 years of experience in the industry, with 5 years of experience as an AI Architect or in a similar position 
• Experience with traditional AI, NLP, LLMs, and Agentic AI solutions 
• Comfortable with the machine learning lifecycle and MLOps and DevOps principles 
• Experience with modern Data & AI platforms 
• Experience with at least one cloud provider and good knowledge of the data ecosystem 
• Strong communication skills and stakeholder management skills
• Master or PhD in Computer Engineering, IT, Artificial Intelligence, or related field
• TOGAF, AI, and Data certifications are a plus 
• You are proficient in English, and in Dutch or French

Your profile

• 
Personal qualities: Ability to work effectively in a team, adapt quickly in an Agile environment and develop a positive working attitude with technical teams, colleagues and customers.

At Secamo, we help organizations build cyber resilience through strategy, controls, and continuous monitoring — across IT, OT, and cloud environments. To support our growth, we’re looking for a motivated professional to join our team.

Location: Offices in Gent and Antwerp
Your role
As a Cybersecurity Strategy Consultant, you will play a pivotal role advising our clients on how to align their security posture with business goals, regulatory requirements, and the evolving threat landscape. You will lead strategic cybersecurity engagements, shape frameworks and roadmaps, and partner closely with senior leaders (C-suite, IT leadership, operations, OT, risk) to translate strategy into action. We’re specifically looking for a strategy consultant who also brings hands-on technical experience and can bridge the gap between strategy and execution.

 
What you’ll do
• Assess client cybersecurity maturity (IT, OT, Cloud), identify gaps, recommend improvements, and define prioritized initiatives.
• Design and refine governance, risk & compliance (GRC) frameworks suited to client risk appetite and regulatory context.
• Collaborate with technical teams to ensure strategy is actionable: helping translate strategic objectives into measurable control implementations.
• Provide thought leadership and subject-matter expertise: staying current with cyber-threat trends, regulatory developments (e.g. GDPR, NIS2, etc.), and emerging best practices.
• Support the implementation and monitoring of cybersecurity metrics, KPIs, and metrics dashboards, to enable transparent reporting at executive, managerial, and operational levels.
• Mentor and guide more junior consultants in strategic thinking, stakeholder engagement, and problem solving.
 

What we are looking for
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems or related field.
• 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity strategy, risk management, security governance, or related consulting roles.
• Experience across IT, OT (Operational Technology), and Cloud environments. Deep understanding of cybersecurity frameworks, regulatory compliance, threat landscape, incident response, and cyber resilience.
• Demonstrated technical, hands-on experience (e.g. incident response, forensics, ethical hacking, or other technical cybersecurity analysis).
• Strong consultancy skills and excellent communication skills (written & verbal) in English and Dutch.
• Ability to work in ambiguous environments, define priorities, and deliver strategic clarity.

As a Senior Data Architect, you are responsible for designing and shaping modern enterprise data platforms that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. You define data architecture strategies, establish best practices, and lead the design of scalable, secure, and high-performing data ecosystems, with a strong focus on Databricks and Microsoft Azure.
Your responsibilities include:
• Designing and implementing enterprise-wide data architectures on Azure and Databricks.
• Defining data platform roadmaps, architecture standards, and governance frameworks.
• Leading the design of modern data lakehouse architectures using Databricks.
• Collaborating with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, BI teams, and senior leadership to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
• Defining data modeling strategies for analytical and operational use cases.
• Ensuring data quality, security, compliance, and governance across the data landscape.
• Providing architectural guidance and technical leadership to delivery teams.
• Evaluating emerging technologies and recommending improvements to the data platform ecosystem.
• Documenting architecture decisions, technical standards, and best practices.
What we expect from you
• Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Architect, Senior Data Engineer, or in a similar data-focused role.
• Proven experience designing and implementing large-scale data platforms on Microsoft Azure.
• Strong hands-on expertise with Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Data Workflows, and Lakehouse Architecture.

YOUR ROLE

As a SAP Technical Architect you will drive successful delivery of complex SAP integration projects by aligning business requirements with technical best practices using SAP and OnPrem integration tools.

 

• You will join the technical team , a crew of warm and trustworthy people embracing innovation and empowering each other for personal and professional growth. With a shared goal in mind, the team allows its members to explore and drive groundbreaking solutions using SAP, creating a stimulating environment shaped for success by trust and collaboration.
• Provide performant integration solution and workflow processes in a secure way
• Define project scopes and join forces with functional and technical consultants to translate requirements into technical specifications
• Create waterproof integration designs and manage project implementations
• Stay current on relevant SAP industry trends , and best practices
• Mentor junior team members by sharing knowledge and expertise and promote a collaborative learning culture

YOUR PROFILE

• A bachelor's or master's degree combined with 10+ years of SAP project experience
• You know the SAP Cloud and OnPrem integration suite and are familiar with terms like REST/OData, Json, XML, SSL, Groovy, SAML,.. SAP Certifications are a plus
• Knowledge on the different BTP components for integration, development, extensibility, …
• Analytical problem-solving abilities to identify issues and propose innovative solutions

Over ViaMotive
 

ViaMotive is not a standard company.
 

We are a challenger in the market of buses and mobility solutions. As a multi-brand distributor of brands like Higer, Temsa and EVM, we work every day on smart solutions for professional passenger transport.
 

Besides sales, we strongly focus on maintenance, repairs and service. With the rise of electric buses, our workshop is evolving - and that’s where we need you.
 

Your role
 

As a bus technician, you work on both diesel and electric buses. You combine mechanical skills with electrical and electronic knowledge, and you will have the opportunity to develop further in this area.
 

You will be part of a small, growing team and receive guidance from an experienced workshop manager.
 

What will you do?
 

You make sure buses stay in top technical condition:
 
 

• Vehicle preparation: checking new buses arriving from the factory and installing required options 

• Electrical systems & diagnostics: working on electric buses, analysing faults and performing diagnostics using software and measuring tools 

• Maintenance & repairs: performing maintenance and repairs (mechanical and electrical), both planned and unexpected 

• Mechanics: repairs on brakes, suspension, drivetrain and other mechanical parts 

• Breakdowns & interventions: handling breakdowns and interventions on-site when needed 

• Administration: correctly registering completed work in the system 

Who are you?
 

You are a technician who likes to learn and grow in a changing sector.
 
 

• You have experience in a technical role (buses, trucks or vans is a plus), or you have strong electrical knowledge and are willing to learn 

• You have knowledge of both mechanics and electricity, and experience with diagnostics and electronic systems 

• You work independently, take responsibility and have a hands-on approach 

• You are interested in electric vehicles and want to develop further in this field 

• You have a category B driving licence 

• You are willing to be part of an on-call system 

• You can communicate well in English or Dutch  

Nice to have
 
 

• HEV technician certification (E2/E3) or willing to get it 

• Driving licence D  

Practical
 
 

• Working hours: daytime (Monday to Friday) 

• Regular travel for breakdowns, mainly during working hours

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Third Party Risk Management Expert - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

As a Third-Party Technology Risk Management (TPTRM) Expert in our CoE Security - Governance, Risk & Compliance team, you will assess, evaluate and monitor IT and cybersecurity risks related to intragroup and external suppliers. Join our Brussels-based team of 10 specialists, where you will collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure robust risk management in a dynamic environment.

 

AND IN DETAIL

• Conduct comprehensive IT and cyber risk assessments of third-party suppliers (intragroup and external) and cloud-based solutions to evaluate their cybersecurity posture, IT controls, and compliance with regulatory requirements.
• Review, challenge, negotiate, and embed IT and cybersecurity clauses in supplier contracts, collaborating with Procurement, Legal, and Business teams.
• Coordinate onsite audits, validate findings, and drive remediation plans with third parties, escalating critical risks to stakeholders.
• Track third-party security posture through periodic reviews (vulnerability reports, incident responses, compliance attestations) and synthesize risks for senior management via dashboards.
• Enhance TPTRM methodologies, tools, and templates (e.g., risk assessment questionnaires, audit guidelines) to reflect emerging threats and regulatory changes.
